# Twitter Bootstrap 2.0.2

Unmodified Bootstrap CSS, responsive CSS, and Glyphicons Halflings sprite images
are vendored from the official `twbs/bootstrap` tag `v2.0.2`, commit
`59503e71ff06d0fd065c2fb981f55f4651ebc274`.

- Bootstrap: copyright 2012 Twitter, Inc.; Apache License 2.0. See `LICENSE` and
  <https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0>.
- Glyphicons Halflings: provided by <https://glyphicons.com/>. Attribution and
  original distribution: <https://getbootstrap.com/2.0.2/base-css.html#icons>.

Only styles and images are used. No Bootstrap JavaScript or jQuery is included.
These demo assets are not runtime dependencies of the TikiTaki core package.
